prompt:
Research the officially documented limits of the Home Assistant Cloud (Nabu Casa) subscription: price per month and what is included. Cite the Nabu Casa page and quote it.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
The Home Assistant Cloud subscription, provided by Nabu Casa, offers region-specific pricing and a suite of features focused on remote access, voice integration, and cloud backups. Below are the officially documented limits regarding price and included features.

**Pricing**
The monthly cost varies by region. In the United States and for international users, the monthly fee is $6.50 USD, excluding local taxes. In the European Union, it is €7.50 EUR (including VAT), and in the United Kingdom, it is £6.50 GBP (including VAT). Canada is priced at $8.70 CAD (excluding VAT). An annual subscription is also available, often described as "a year for the price of 10 months."

SOURCE: https://www.nabucasa.com/pricing/ | QUOTE: "The monthly subscription costs 6.50 USD. The annual subscription costs 65 USD. This price is excluding local sales tax." | CLAIM: The monthly price for US and International users is $6.50 USD, excluding tax.
SOURCE: https://www.nabucasa.com/pricing/ | QUOTE: "The monthly subscription costs 7.50 EUR. The annual subscription costs 75 EUR. This price includes value-added tax (VAT)." | CLAIM: The monthly price for EU users is €7.50 EUR, including VAT.
SOURCE: https://www.nabucasa.com/pricing/ | QUOTE: "The monthly subscription costs 6.50 GBP. The annual subscription costs 65 GBP. This price includes value-added tax (VAT)." | CLAIM: The monthly price for UK users is £6.50 GBP, including VAT.
SOURCE: https://www.nabucasa.com/pricing/ | QUOTE: "The monthly subscription costs 8.70 CAD. The annual subscription costs 87 CAD. This price is excluding local value-added tax (VAT)." | CLAIM: The monthly price for Canadian users is $8.70 CAD, excluding VAT.
SOURCE: https://www.nabucasa.com/link/ | QUOTE: "A year for the price of 10 months" | CLAIM: The annual subscription plan offers a discount equivalent to two free months compared to the monthly rate.

**Included Features**
The subscription includes secure remote access, voice assistant integration (Alexa, Google Home, and Home Assistant Assist), improved text-to-speech, offsite cloud backups, and enhanced media streaming capabilities.

SOURCE: https://support.nabucasa.com/hc/en-us/articles/26260474250269-List-of-Home-Assistant-Cloud-features | QUOTE: "Home Assistant Cloud provides the following features: - Secure remote access to your Home Assistant (previously called Remote UI) - Easy integration with popular voice assistants, such as Home Assistant Assist, Amazon Alexa, or Google Assistant - Improved text-to-speech to have text read aloud with natural sounding voices. - Cloud storage of your latest Home Assistant backup - Webhooks, for example to trigger automations. - Improved camera streaming with WebRTC" | CLAIM: The subscription includes secure remote access, voice assistant integration, improved TTS, cloud backups, webhooks, and improved camera streaming.
SOURCE: https://www.nabucasa.com/link/ | QUOTE: "- Remote Access - Offsite Backups - Voice control (Alexa & Google Home) - Voice Processing (STT/TTS) - Better media streaming (video/audio) - Dedicated Support* - Funds the development of Home Assistant" | CLAIM: Additional listed benefits include dedicated support for Link features and funding the development of Home Assistant.

**Payment Methods**
Nabu Casa accepts Credit Cards, Google Pay, Apple Pay, and PayPal. They do not offer lifetime subscriptions or one-time fees.

SOURCE: https://www.nabucasa.com/pricing/ | QUOTE: "We support four payment methods: Credit Card, Google Pay, Apple Pay, or PayPal." | CLAIM: The accepted payment methods are Credit Card, Google Pay, Apple Pay, and PayPal.
SOURCE: https://support.nabucasa.com/hc/en-us/sections/26179596492061-FAQ-Subscription-and-payments | QUOTE: "We don’t offer a lifetime subscription, one-time payment, or student discount." | CLAIM: There are no lifetime, one-time, or student discount options available.
